title: Journal
description: What the journal app's parts pass between them on one computer (ADR 0011). ReaderDay is what the reader prints with `jellymoon day`: one local day of what a person typed to their agents. None of it is sent to a pod.
x-rules: A turn is in a ReaderDay only when the session log marks it as typed by a person. Tool results, task notices, compaction summaries, sidechains, slash-command wrappers and prompts sent by other programs are left out.
Blocks the harness adds to a person's prompt are cut out of said. A turn with nothing left is left out.
Text shaped like a credential is replaced in said and in reply before either is cut to its length. A text that was cut ends in an ellipsis.
at and day are in the computer's local time zone. Turns are in the order they were typed.

ReaderTurn.description: One thing a person typed to an agent, with the agent's last text reply before the person typed again.

at.description: The local time the person typed it, as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock.

project.description: The last segment of the folder the session ran in, or the worktree's name when that folder is inside a harness worktree.

reply.description: The agent's last text reply in the turn. Empty when it has not replied in text.

ReaderDay.description: One local calendar day of what a person typed to their agents: the reader's whole output.

day.description: The local calendar day, as YYYY-MM-DD.
